question: peak_hour
text: For turbine 8, using the 14-day SCADA record ending on day 214 (days 201 through 214, 10-minute sampling), produce a 48-hour-ahead forecast of active power: 288 values in kW, one per 10-minute step, beginning with the first step after the last row of the history. Also report the hour of the horizon, counted 1 to 48, in which the mean forecast power is highest.

question: energy_kwh
text: For turbine 8, using the 14-day SCADA record ending on day 220 (days 207 through 220, 10-minute sampling), produce a 48-hour-ahead forecast of active power: 288 values in kW, one per 10-minute step, beginning with the first step after the last row of the history. Also report the energy the forecast implies over the horizon, in kWh: the sum of the 10-minute values divided by 6.
